name: Hangeul Fonts
original_description: Find free Korean (Hangeul) fonts that fit your design and check whether each one is allowed for your use: web, print, video, logo, packaging, app embedding or PDF embedding. License verdicts come from a curated dataset with links to each font's official license text, and fonts that can't be verified are marked unknown. Results include ready-to-use CSS, Tailwind and Figma values, direct links to the official font files, and steps for using them in local files such as PDFs, slides and HTML. No account is required.
